items.text: The Technology the World relies on was invented in America. items.text: The Ballroom is coming along fantastically well. items.summary_cn: Trump抨击美联储（'Too Late'）成本/工期失控，并提及建设含DronePort的军事项目，涉及对美联储的施压叙事。
